plugin.name: Model marketplace
plugin.description: Search public 3D sources, see preview, author and licence, and load a model into the current model.

panel.title: Model marketplace
panel.placeholder: What are you looking for? e.g. chair
panel.placePlaceholder: A place or address, e.g. Marienplatz Munich
panel.nothing: Nothing found. Try another word, in English if you can.
panel.privacy: Nothing is sent until you search. A search goes to {source}.
panel.untested: Not tested with a real key yet. If something fails, please tell us.

key.forSearch: {source} only answers with your own key.
key.forDownload: Searching works without a key. To load a model, {source} needs your own API token.
key.label: Your key
key.stored: The key stays in this browser and only goes to this source.

item.author: Author
item.linkOnly: {source} only allows downloads when logged in on its site. Open the page, download the file and import it.
item.places: Loads the buildings within {radius} m of this place as simple blocks, with heights where the map knows them.

license.free: Free to use for anything; no credit needed.
license.attribution: Name the author and follow the licence when you share or sell your work. Some licences forbid commercial use or changes: read it first.
license.unknown: The licence is not known yet. Check the page at the source before you use the model.

load.starting: Asking the source, this can take a moment…
load.millimetres: The file has no unit and looked too big for metres, so it was read as millimetres.

credits.hint: Author and licence stay with each loaded model, also in the saved file. Exports to other formats do not carry them: copy them if you pass the work on.
credits.empty: Nothing loaded from a source yet.

errors.network: {source} could not be reached. Are you online? The service may also not allow calls from a web page.
errors.rate: {source} has had too many requests. Try again later.
errors.server: {source} has a problem right now. Try again later.
errors.noBuildings: The map knows no buildings around this place.
errors.noFile: {source} offers no file for this model that can be loaded here.
errors.tooLarge: The model is bigger than {limit} MB and was not loaded.
errors.noModel: The download holds no model in a format that can be loaded here.
errors.compressed: This model is compressed in a way that cannot be read yet.
errors.remote: The file points to an address outside itself and was not opened.
errors.missingPart: A part of the model is missing from the download.
errors.format: The file has a format that cannot be read here.
